title: Grouping
description: Versioned mapping of many source levels onto fewer target levels. A first-class auditable modelling decision, not a convenience (02 FR-MODEL-13..17, §4.3).

credibility_model.description: Recorded per grouping; it is a modelling judgement, not a platform constant (FR-MODEL-80; OQ-MODEL-5 decided 2026-08-15).

credibility_pk.description: The (p, k) pair credibility_standard_claims was derived from — p=0.90, k=0.05 gives 1082 claims. Without it the standard is an unattributable number (FR-MODEL-80).

unseen_level_behaviour.description: Mandatory; there is no implicit default (FR-MODEL-13).

parent_grouping_id.description: Set for a hierarchical chain, e.g. outcode -> area -> region (FR-MODEL-17).

evidence.description: Grouping must be defensible as a modelling decision (FR-MODEL-15).

credibility_components.description: Buhlmann-Straub variance components, so a reviewer can re-derive Z rather than take it. Null under limited fluctuation (FR-MODEL-80). All three are strictly positive because a non-positive EVPV or VHM is refused with CREDIBILITY_VARIANCE_NOT_ESTIMABLE rather than clamped (FR-MODEL-113) - only k carried the bound until 2026-08-22, so a zero or negative variance component validated against a contract the platform would never emit. NOTE: this k is EVPV/VHM, Buhlmann-Straub's credibility constant. It is NOT method_params.credibility_pk.k, which is limited fluctuation's tolerance (0.05). Two different quantities, one letter, one artifact.

rationale.description: Appears verbatim in the generated dossier (06 §4.4 §4).

invariants: mapping covers every level observed on derived_on_dataset_version_id
